atts.title: Build, ship, share, iterate.
atts.subtitle: We were born in late 2023, from a group of friends who met at hackathons and wanted to build something. Not just build it: ship it, share it, get feedback, iterate, and create real value for someone in the world.
atts.heading: h2

atts.text: In 2025 we decided to share what we had learned with the LATAM community. We organized the first Code Brew and 15 people showed up: designers, engineers, self-taught builders, YouTubers, and Platzi teachers. Amazing people.
Since then we have hosted hackathons, more Code Brews, and product launches. We knew there was something here: a culture worth growing.
